audit.why: Graves owns levels 1-2 on shotgun burst and keg denial, 3 through 6 is skill, Gangplank takes first item and 2+ — that shape matches a narrow 51.96% win rate over 2885 games and matches the prose exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 danger spike had no cooldown on it, so 'his window, not yours' read as opinion.
audit.why: Collateral Damage is 100/80/60 against Cannon Barrage's 160/140/120 — he gets his ultimate back far faster than you do, which is the actual reason level 6 favours him.
audit.corrected: 100s stated in spikes[2] and mid; Smoke Screen's 26s at rank 1 stated in early as the trading window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors repeated across seven fields. (1) Smoke Screen is called a BLIND that stops your Parrrley. Riot's text: it 'creat[es] a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range' plus impact damage and a brief slow — it is a nearsight, not a blind, and it does not stop your abilities from landing. (2) 'End of the Line slow' — Q has no slow at all; it is an explosive shell that detonates after 1 second or on terrain contact. The slow belongs to W.
audit.why: A player told his smoke blinds them will refuse to Parrrley inside it and give up free trades on a false premise. The Q/W slow mix-up sends Remove Scurvy at the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Nearsight language used in whys[3], spikes[2], early, mid, wants.you[2] and wants.foe[2]; Remove Scurvy retargeted at the Smoke Screen slow. The terrain-detonation retreat cut added to mid with Flash held for the wall.
sources: brief enemyKit W and Q text

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer treats Quickdraw as a cooldown you can wait out.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill and refreshes the resistance boost.' Against a farming Graves the 16/15/14/13/12 base is much shorter in practice, so 'engage when Quickdraw is down' is only true if he has not been auto-attacking.
audit.corrected: Not rewritten — the Quickdraw focus chain runs through ~10 cross-referenced full-layer fields. Flagged in notes so the user can decide whether to retarget the whole chain.

audit.why: All three packet suspectNames ('Powder Kegs', 'His Collateral Damage', 'Use Remove Scurvy') are false positives — correct names with a leading word counted as edit distance.
audit.corrected: No name changes made on that basis.

edits.before: You can poke him with Q-into-keg when he walks up, but he answers with shotgun burst and a Smoke Screen blind — it stays a skill matchup.
edits.after: You can poke him with Q-into-keg when he walks up, but he answers with shotgun burst and a Smoke Screen nearsight — it stays a skill matchup.

edits.before: His Collateral Damage window is the danger spike — the R cone plus Quickdraw dash and a Smoke Screen blind let him all-in you, while your Cannon Barrage only zones.
edits.after: His Collateral Damage window is the danger spike — a 100s R cone plus the Quickdraw dash and Smoke Screen's nearsight let him all-in you, while your Cannon Barrage only zones.

edits.before: Use Remove Scurvy to cleanse his Smoke Screen blind and his End of the Line slow, then heal the burst back
edits.after: Use Remove Scurvy on the Smoke Screen slow — the smoke nearsights you, not blinds — then heal the burst back

edits.before: Drop Smoke Screen on you to blind your Parrrley and Q-poke, then collapse with Collateral Damage when you are zoned off the wave
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen to nearsight you off your keg placements and slow you, then collapse with Collateral Damage when you are zoned off the wave

edits.before: Graves owns these levels and you cannot fight it head-on — his double-shell shotgun autos out-burst your single Parrrley, and worse, he just walks up and free-hits your Powder Kegs to pop them before they ever detonate, denying your whole kit. Do not place a keg in his auto range expecting value; set them at the edge of your control just to zone and CS with cannon Q last-hits. Respect that his Smoke Screen blinds your Parrrley, so save your trades for when it is on cooldown.
edits.after: Graves owns these levels and you cannot fight it head-on — his shotgun autos out-burst your single Parrrley, and worse, he walks up and free-hits your Powder Keg to pop it before it ever detonates, denying your whole kit. Don't place a keg in his auto range expecting value; set them at the edge of your control and CS with cannon Q last-hits. Smoke Screen doesn't blind you — it nearsights and slows on impact, 26s at rank 1 — so trade in that downtime.

edits.before: Now you stabilize. With a second Q and E point you can land Parrrley into a keg detonation when he steps up to farm, chipping him without committing to a brawl you would lose. At 6 stay disciplined — his Collateral Damage cone, Quickdraw dash, and Smoke Screen make HIS ultimate window the all-in, not yours; your Cannon Barrage only zones and skirmishes, it does not win the duel. Hold Remove Scurvy to cleanse his End of the Line slow and the Smoke Screen blind, heal the poke back, and keep farming toward your item spike.
edits.after: Now you stabilize. With a second Q and E point you can land Parrrley into a keg detonation when he steps up to farm, chipping him without committing to a brawl you would lose. At 6 stay disciplined — Collateral Damage on 100s plus the Quickdraw dash make HIS window the all-in, not yours; Cannon Barrage only zones. End of the Line detonates on terrain, so he can cut your retreat along a wall and you have no dash — hold Flash for that, not the damage. Save Remove Scurvy for the Smoke Screen slow.

notes: Smoke Screen was described as a BLIND in six places. Riot's text gives sight-range reduction (nearsight) plus impact damage and a brief slow — nothing that stops Parrrley from landing. That error changes how a player trades inside the cloud, so it was the priority fix. 'End of the Line slow' was also wrong: Q has no slow, it detonates after 1s or on terrain. QUESTION FOR THE USER, left unactioned: the full layer times this entire lane off Quickdraw's cooldown, but Riot's E text says basic attacks lower that cooldown and refresh the resistances, so against a farming Graves it is rarely actually down.
